records.name: Elon Musk Grant
records.notes: Elon Musk donated $10M to FLI in January 2015 for AI safety research. The funds were used to run the 2015 AI Safety Grant Program, which funded 37 projects totaling $7M+ to researchers at Oxford, Berkeley, Carnegie Mellon, MIRI, and other institutions.

records.name: Open Philanthropy AI Risk Grant
records.notes: Open Philanthropy (then Open Philanthropy Project) provided $1.186M as a supplement to the Musk 2015 grant round, funding high-quality proposals that exceeded the initial Musk funding.

records.name: Vitalik Buterin SHIB Donation
records.notes: Vitalik Buterin donated ~$665.8M nominal value in SHIB tokens to FLI in 2021. Approximately $500M was realized after liquidation.
